record.question: Which of the following statement is false about resistivity method?
options: The small inter- electrode distances provide a very detailed image of near- surface inhomogeneities.
An apparent resistivity map for a given electrode spacing indicates the general lateral variation in electrical properties in the area.
If the data of Wenner sounding, the measured resistivity is plotted on the x-axis and the electrode separation on the y- axes.
The data of Schlumberger sounding are plotted with electrode separation along the x-axis. This data should be drawn on a double logarithmic paper.
